instruction: Please help me configure Chrome's network request priority algorithm to prioritize image requests over script requests. This would improve the perceived page load speed for image-heavy websites I frequently visit.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome's resource loading priority algorithm is hardcoded based on web standards and browser optimization heuristics. The browser automatically determines resource priorities (scripts, stylesheets, images, etc.) according to HTML5 specifications and cannot be manually configured by users.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Chrome does not expose user-configurable settings for network request priority algorithms
The resource loading priority is hardcoded in the browser engine according to HTML5 specifications and web standards
The infeasible() evaluator function is appropriate for tasks that cannot be completed
No semantic verification issues - infeasible tasks do not require verification logic
